Name: Item Duplicator
Author: AlvarusOnly
Description:
[size=4][b]Description
[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Item Duplicator[/b] is a Stardew Valley mod for SMAPI that adds a dedicated in-game duplication system, allowing players to duplicate items quickly and conveniently without using item IDs, console commands, or external tools. For Android version you can check on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50967][u]Item Duplicator Android[/u][/url].
Features
[b]9 Duplication Slots[/b]
The mod provides nine item slots arranged in a 3×3 layout. Players can place items from their inventory into these slots and choose which items they want to duplicate.
[b]Manual Duplication[/b]
Press [b]“Duplicate Now”[/b] to duplicate all items currently placed in the duplication slots. The amount duplicated can be customized using the quantity setting.
[b]Automatic Duplication[/b]
The [b]AUTO[/b] feature allows items to be duplicated automatically. Once enabled, the mod will continuously duplicate the items placed in the slots according to the configured duplication interval.
[b]Stackable & Non-Stackable Items[/b]
Stackable items are handled by increasing their quantity while respecting the game's maximum stack size. If the resulting amount exceeds the maximum stack size, the excess items are automatically placed into the player's inventory as additional stacks.
Non-stackable items, such as tools, are handled separately. The mod creates a new copy of the item and attempts to add it directly to the player's inventory.
[b]Quality Selection[/b]
Item Duplicator includes four quality options:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Normal[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Silver[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Gold[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Iridium[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]The selected quality is applied to items that support Stardew Valley's quality system.
Items that do not support quality are duplicated normally without attempting to modify their quality.
[b]Custom Duplication Amount[/b]
The [b]“Amount per Click”[/b] setting allows players to determine how many items should be duplicated during each manual duplication action.
This setting can also be used together with automatic duplication.
[b]Take All[/b]
The [b]“Take All”[/b] button allows players to quickly retrieve every item currently stored in the duplication slots and return them to their inventory.
[b]Safe Menu Closing[/b]
Closing the menu using [b]Esc[/b] or the [b]X[/b] button automatically returns items remaining inside the duplication slots to the player's inventory.
If an item is currently being held by the mouse cursor when the menu closes, it will also be returned to the inventory.
Configuration
Item Duplicator provides several configuration options through[/color]

[code]config.json[/code][color=#D4D4D8].
Available settings include:[/color]

[list]
[*][code]OpenMenuKey[/code][color=#D4D4D8]— The keyboard key used to open the duplication menu. The default key is [b]F8[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][code]AmountPerTick[/code][color=#D4D4D8]— Determines how many items are duplicated during each automatic duplication process.[/color][/*]
[*][code]TicksPerDuplicate[/code][color=#D4D4D8]— Controls the interval between automatic duplication processes.[/color][/*]
[*][code]AutoDuplicate[/code][color=#D4D4D8]— Determines whether automatic duplication is enabled by default.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]These settings allow players to customize the mod's behavior according to their preferred gameplay style.
Compatibility
Item Duplicator uses Stardew Valley's item system rather than relying on a fixed list of item IDs. This allows the mod to work with a wide variety of items that can be processed through the game's inventory system.
Items with special properties may behave differently depending on how Stardew Valley handles them internally.
Recommended Usage
Item Duplicator is primarily intended for [b]single-player gameplay[/b]. It can be useful for:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Testing items and game mechanics[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Experimenting with different item qualities[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Building item collections[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Creating resources for testing[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Saving time when obtaining large quantities of items[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Mod testing and development[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Sandbox-style gameplay[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Because the mod allows items to be duplicated, using it in multiplayer may affect the balance of the game or the shared economy. Multiplayer use is therefore best done only when all players agree.
Simple, Fast, and Convenient
Item Duplicator is designed to make item duplication straightforward. Instead of remembering item IDs or entering console commands, players can simply open the menu, place an item into one of the nine slots, choose the desired quantity and quality, and press [b]“Duplicate Now.”[/b]
For players who want even more convenience, the [b]AUTO[/b] feature can handle repeated duplication automatically.
Whether you are testing a mod, preparing resources, experimenting with item qualities, or simply want a faster way to obtain items, [b]Item Duplicator[/b] provides a simple and flexible solution directly inside Stardew Valley.[/color]
